notes.text: A bill's link now opens in the app instead of the browser, with its photos and comments.
A bill's link that is no longer shared, or that only the people in the bill can open, now says so instead of showing an error.
A profile's link now opens even when you haven't signed in.
Profile › Privacy and about has a new switch, "Share usage data": turn it off to stop sending how you use the app.
The links you share to your profile, to a comment and to get the app now show their preview in your language.
Amounts and labels no longer break across lines or get cut off on small screens, foldables and with large text.
Text, buttons and outlines that were hard to read now have more contrast, in the light and dark themes.
Tapping a field in an iPhone's browser no longer zooms the page.
A bill can now be split By income, and the incomes you type are shared with the group's members.
Each of Home's Latest expenses now has a menu: Edit, Duplicate, Share and Delete.
See all on Home now opens All expenses: every bill you're part of, across your groups, with search, filters and sorting.
A group's photo is now bigger at the top of its screen and shrinks as you scroll, and opening a group animates from its row.
Activity now shows people's photos, Balances › By group shows each group's photo, and Statistics' Biggest expense shows its category.
Profile › Account and sync now shows the Google or Apple logo and your whole email, which only you see.
Delete account now explains what stays in your groups after your account is gone.
The Default Pix key switch no longer looks off on your default key in the dark theme.
Blitz Split now speaks Dutch, Japanese, Turkish and Indonesian, and the language list names each language in its own language.
Groups and bills can now use the Polish zloty, the Turkish lira and the Indonesian rupiah.
Profile has a new button, Share profile: whoever opens your link sees your name and photo and can invite you to a group.
A new group's invite link is ready right away, even offline, and Members has a new button to copy it.
Closing a form with something you haven't saved now asks "Discard changes?" first.
The Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service now open inside the app instead of the browser.
On a phone, the top and bottom bars now get out of the way when you scroll down and come back when you scroll up.
On Split a bill, picking a date no longer jumps straight to the clock: the time has its own button.
Tap the group at the top of Split a bill to open it; going back returns to the bill with everything you typed.
Home's Latest expenses now show each bill's group and who paid as photos.
Pix now shows only to people likely to use it, such as those using the app in Portuguese, with a Pix key or in a group in reais.
"Syncing…" now shows only the first time your account loads on a device, not on every sync.
Profile no longer offers to disconnect Google or Apple from your account: sign out or delete the account instead.
Edit profile now opens as a sheet over Profile instead of a separate screen.
The blank band between the form and the keyboard on Split a bill is gone.
A contact's Groups in common now show each group's photo.
Tap a group's photo at the top of its screen to see it big, and change or remove it right there.
Blitz Split now speaks German, Italian and Polish: it follows your device's language, or you can pick one in Profile › Language.
Every category now has its own color, and Statistics draws each category and each person in theirs.
You can now change a category's color, in the category's form or in Category map.
A bill's menu on Expenses has a new option, Duplicate: it opens a new bill already filled in like the original.
Groups and bills no longer disappear for a moment when you come back to the app.
Search no longer closes right away when you don't have a group yet.
A new group now starts as Event, the first type on the list.
With no group yet, Invite with link or QR now shows only the New group button instead of buttons you couldn't use.
A receipt that takes longer to read no longer ends in a connection error.
Statistics' category rows are cleaner: they no longer list each subcategory's amount.
Blitz Split is a new app, rebuilt from scratch: it replaces Blitz Split 2.4.0 and runs on Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web.
Split a bill equally, by amounts, by percentages, by shares or item by item, with one person or several paying.
Scan a receipt and the app reads its items and total for you.
Create groups for trips, home or events and invite people with a link or a QR code.
See who owes whom in each group and across all of them, record payments and simplify debts so fewer payments settle everything.
Everything works offline: what you do is saved on your device and goes out when you're back online.
An account is optional: connect Google or Apple, or keep a recovery code, to get your groups back on another device.
Comment on a bill, attach photos, follow what happened in Activity and see where the money went in Statistics.
Each bill and each payment has its own currency, and the app comes in English, Portuguese, Spanish and French.
